reviewNotes: George's complete six-line schedule dialogue asset is translated directly from English, preserving his gruff clinic, saloon and religious humor, with all controls exact.

23.000.source: Hmmpph... The wife's making me go to the clinic today.
23.000.translation: Hmmph... Nevastă-mea mă pune să merg la clinică astăzi.

winter_17.000.source: I'm just here for the free coffee.
winter_17.000.translation: Sunt aici doar pentru cafeaua gratis.

Sun.000.source: I've never been religious but hey... I'm old.
Sun.000.translation: N-am fost niciodată credincios, dar na... sunt bătrân.

23.002.source: Well how much longer do I have, Doc?
23.002.translation: Ei bine, cât timp mai am, doctore?

Sun.001.source: Hehehe... I skipped church to come here! I hope Yoba isn't too angry with me.$h
Sun.001.translation: Hehehe... Am chiulit de la biserică ca să vin aici! Sper că Yoba nu este prea supărat pe mine.$h
